title: 第7章 驯化第8章 明劲第9章 王家
content_zh:
;;
石头村。
夜黑风高。
王大山一身酒气，心满意足的躺在房间内。
今日他刚得知，陈三石被张家在县城收拾了，张家明天会继续开荒，让他不要担心，还为他送来了酒肉。
悬在心头的那颗石头，总算是落下了。
他躺在床上，正在做他的地主梦。
半个时辰后。
一道黑影靠近院子，在门口转悠了会，确定里面的人睡着后，这才撬开房门，快速溜进房间内。
借着月光看到躺在床上熟睡的身影。
他没有丝毫犹豫，一刀刺入那人心脏位置，一手捂住对方嘴巴。
王大山瞬间惊醒，想要叫出声，却被那人死死的捂住嘴巴，鲜血从那人的手掌缝隙中冒出来。
“噗嗤！”
陈三石眼疾手快，连续继续几刀刺入又拔出，最后为了保险起见，还在王大山脖子上用力一刀抹过去。
热乎乎的鲜血溅得他一脸。
王大山瞬间没有了动静。
“呸。”
“等着吧，张家的那群杂碎，很快就会去找你。”
陈三石往王大山那张吓人的脸上吐了口痰，随后在房屋内搜刮了一番，原以为王大山为张家做事，多少能够攒点银两，让他回到城里，能购买一些气血补汤，提升修炼进度。
怎料除了一锅残羹剩饭之外，家里什么也没剩下。

他潜伏在村子内半个晚上，正是饥肠辘辘的时候，情不自禁喝了几口浓汤，将几个馒头塞进怀里，这才从屋子内溜出来。
然而脑袋刚从屋子内探头，便有一抹石灰，撒在他脸上。
接着几道拳影砸来。
不等他拔出腰间短刀，便邦邦几拳砸在他胸口上，将他砸进了屋子内，刚吞进去肚子内的馒头往上窜，差点将他噎死。
胸口疼得裂开，却叫不出声来。
想要站起来时。
一把钢叉锁喉，将他按在了地上，另一个魁梧的汉子，双脚踩在他脚踝处，似乎只要稍微用点力，就能够打断他四肢，让他丧失练武的能力。
也在这时，一名少年，面无表情的从门外走进来。
点燃屋子内的烛火。
见到王大山的死状后，微微皱了下眉头，便坐在了一张凳子上。
刚刚出手制服他的两人，将他从地上拽起来，两人同时锁住他的琵琶骨，将他的双手往背后高高架起，做飞机状。
眼看着他脸越涨越红，可能将窒息过去，少年眼神一扫。
较为魁梧的汉子，一拳打在他腹部上，将他肚子内，那口浓汤都给打得喷出来。
“咳咳咳！”
陈三石连续咳嗽了好几声，一脸凶狠的看着那少年。
content_en:
;;
Stone Village.
The night is dark and windy.
Wang Dashan smelled of alcohol and lay contentedly in the room.
Today he just learned that Chen Sanshi was taken care of by the Zhang family in the county. The Zhang family will continue to open up wasteland tomorrow, so he told him not to worry and even brought him food and wine.
The stone hanging in my heart finally fell.
He was lying in bed, dreaming about his landowner dream.
Half an hour later.
A dark figure approached the yard and lingered at the door for a while. After making sure that the person inside was asleep, he opened the door and quickly slipped into the room.
Through the moonlight, I saw the sleeping figure lying on the bed.
Without any hesitation, he stabbed the man's heart with his knife and covered his mouth with one hand.
Wang Dashan woke up instantly and wanted to scream, but the man covered his mouth tightly, and blood came out from the gap in the man's palm.
"Pfft!"
Chen Sanshi, with quick eyes and quick hands, continued to insert and pull out the knife several times. Finally, just to be on the safe side, he swiped the knife on Wang Dashan's neck.
Hot blood splashed all over his face.
Wang Dashan became silent for a moment.
"Bah."
"Just wait, those bastards from the Zhang family will be looking for you soon."
Chen Sanshi spat on Wang Dashan's scary face, and then searched the house. He originally thought that Wang Dashan could save some money by working for the Zhang family, so that when he returned to the city, he could buy some Qi and Blood Tonic Decoction to improve his cultivation progress.
Unexpectedly, there was nothing left at home except a pot of leftovers.
He lurked in the village for half the night. When he was hungry, he couldn't help but drink a few mouthfuls of thick soup, stuffed a few steamed buns into his arms, and then slipped out of the house.
However, as soon as his head poked his head out of the house, there was a splash of lime sprinkled on his face.
Then several fist shadows came.
Before he could pull out the short knife from his waist, Bang Bang punched him in the chest several times and knocked him into the house. The steamed buns he had just swallowed jumped up and almost choked him to death.
My chest was splitting in pain, but I couldn't scream.
When you want to stand up.
A steel fork locked his throat and pinned him to the ground. Another burly man stepped on his ankles with his feet. It seemed that with just a little force, he could break his limbs and make him lose the ability to practice martial arts.
At this moment, a young man walked in from the door with an expressionless face.
Light the candles in the house.
After seeing Wang Dashan's death state, he frowned slightly and sat on a stool.
The two people who had just subdued him pulled him up from the ground. They locked his bones at the same time and raised his hands high behind his back, like an airplane.
Seeing that his face was getting redder and redder, and he might suffocate, the young man glanced at him.
The burlier man punched him in the abdomen, causing the soup in his stomach to spurt out.
"Cough cough cough!"
Chen Sanshi coughed several times in succession and looked at the young man fiercely.
